results.name: Bodyweight Full Squat With Overhead Press
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms extended just in front of your knees.
Lower your body into a squat position until your thighs are parallel to the floor, keeping your back straight.
Stand up from the squat while pressing your hands overhead, extending your arms fully.
Lower your hands back down as you descend into the next squat. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Maintain a neutral spine and avoid rounding your back during the exercise to ensure proper form.
Ensure your knees are aligned with your toes during the squat to prevent strain on your knees.
Avoid locking your elbows when pressing overhead to keep tension on your muscles and protect your joints.
results.description: Bodyweight Full Squat With Overhead Press is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Calves.

results.name: Bodyweight Hip Thrust
instructions: Sit on the ground with your upper back resting against a bench and your knees bent, feet flat on the floor and shoulder-width apart. Cross your arms over your chest.
Engage your core and press through your heels to lift your hips upward until your body forms a straight line from your shoulders to your knees.
Squeeze your glutes at the top of the movement, keeping your chin tucked slightly and your ribs down.
Slowly lower your hips back down to the ground under control. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Press through your heels, not your toes, to better target the glutes.
Exhale as you lift your hips and inhale as you lower them.
Pause and squeeze your glutes at the top for 1–2 seconds to maximize activation.
results.description: Bodyweight Hip Thrust is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings.

results.name: Bodyweight Kneeling Hold to Stand
instructions: Start by kneeling on the floor with both knees, hands placed on your hips.
Lift your right foot and place it flat on the floor in front of you, transitioning into a half-kneeling position.
Push through your right foot to stand up fully, bringing your left foot to meet your right.
Lower back down into the half-kneeling position, then return to the original kneeling position. Repeat with the other leg.
tips: Engage your core to maintain balance and stability throughout the exercise.
Keep your back straight and avoid leaning forward as you transition from kneeling to standing.
Perform the movement slowly and with control to maximize muscle activation and prevent injury.
results.description: Bodyweight Kneeling Hold to Stand is a beginner multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings.

results.name: Bodyweight Kneeling Sissy Squat
instructions: Start in a kneeling position with your knees on the floor and your torso upright.
Lean back slowly, keeping your body straight from your knees to your head, engaging your quadriceps.
Return to the upright kneeling position, repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions
tips: Engage your core to maintain stability and prevent your lower back from arching.
Keep your core engaged to stabilize your spine and prevent lower back strain.
Focus on a smooth and steady movement to maintain balance and ensure proper form.
results.description: Bodyweight Kneeling Sissy Squat is an advanced multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Abdominals, Hip Flexors.

results.name: Bodyweight Lying Leg Curl
instructions: Lie down on your stomach while curling your arms at your chest and extend your legs on the floor.
Bend your knees to lift your lower legs towards your glutes, engaging your hamstrings.
Slowly lower your legs back to the starting position.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your hips pressed into the floor to ensure proper form and maximize hamstring engagement.
Squeeze your hamstrings at the top of the movement for a brief hold to enhance muscle contraction.
Perform the movement slowly and with control to maximize muscle activation and prevent injury.
results.description: Bodyweight Lying Leg Curl is a beginner single-joint isolation pulling exercise targeting the hamstrings (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Glutes.

results.name: Bodyweight Overhead Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms extended overhead.
Lower your body into a squat position until your thighs are parallel to the floor, keeping your arms extended overhead.
Stand back up to the starting position, maintaining the arm position throughout.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Engage your core to maintain stability and proper alignment throughout the exercise.
Keep your chest lifted and your back straight to avoid leaning forward excessively.
Ensure your knees are aligned with your toes during the squat to prevent strain on your knees.
results.description: Bodyweight Overhead Squat is an advanced multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Calves.

results.name: Bodyweight Pulse Forward Lunge
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your hands on your hips or by your sides.
Step forward with your right foot and lower your body into a lunge position, ensuring your front knee is aligned over your ankle and your back knee is close to the floor.
Perform small pulsing movements by slightly raising and lowering your body in the lunge position.
Push through your front heel to return to the starting position. Repeat the movement on the other side.
tips: Keep your core engaged and your torso upright to maintain balance and proper form.
Ensure your front knee does not extend past your toes to avoid putting unnecessary strain on your knee.
Perform the pulsing movements slowly and with control to maximize muscle activation and prevent injury.
results.description: Bodyweight Pulse Forward Lunge is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Calves.

results.name: Bodyweight Pulse Squat Arms to Chest
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your hands on crossed at your chest
Lower your body into a squat position, ensuring your thighs are parallel to the floor and your back is straight.
Perform a small pulsing movement by slightly raising and lowering your body in the squat position.
Return to the starting position. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your feet flat on the floor to maintain balance and stability.
Keep your chest lifted and your back straight to avoid leaning forward excessively.
Perform the pulsing movements slowly and with control to maximize muscle activation and prevent injury.
results.description: Bodyweight Pulse Squat Arms to Chest is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Calves.

results.name: Bodyweight Pulse Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your hands on your hips or extended in front of you.
Lower your body into a squat position, ensuring your thighs are parallel to the floor and your back is straight.
Perform a small pulsing movement by slightly raising and lowering your body in the squat position.
Return to the starting position. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your feet flat on the floor to maintain balance and stability.
Keep your chest lifted and your back straight to avoid leaning forward excessively.
Perform the pulsing movements slowly and with control to maximize muscle activation and prevent injury.
results.description: Bodyweight Pulse Squat is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Calves.

results.name: Bodyweight Rear Lunge Front Raise
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms by your sides.
Step backward with your right foot and lower your body into a lunge position while simultaneously raising your arms in front of you to shoulder level.
Ensure your front knee is aligned over your ankle and your back knee is close to the floor.
Push through your front heel to return to the starting position, lowering your arms back to your sides. Repeat the movement with your left foot stepping backward, alternating legs.
tips: Maintain a steady breathing pattern, inhaling as you lunge down and exhaling as you push back up.
Keep your arms straight and parallel to the floor during the front raise to maximize shoulder activation.
Avoid locking your knees when returning to the standing position to keep the tension on your muscles and prevent injury.
results.description: Bodyweight Rear Lunge Front Raise is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Calves.
